dimensions.assessment: Directly affects current and future members of the Catawba Indian Nation.
dimensions.evidence: This bill revises tribal membership requirements for the Catawba Indian Nation

dimensions.assessment: Alters the governing criteria for who can be enrolled as a tribal member by removing federal statutory restrictions.
dimensions.evidence: allows the tribe to determine its membership

dimensions.assessment: No federal spending, revenue, or economic effects are stated or implied in the source material.
Amends a specific subsection of a single previous federal settlement act regarding tribal membership.
dimensions.evidence: Subsection (d) of section 7 of the Catawba Indian Tribe of South Carolina Land Claims Settlement Act of 1993... is amended

dimensions.assessment: Permanent statutory change to the tribe's governing framework.

missing_information: Exact number of individuals whose eligibility would change is not provided.
importance_detail.rationale: The bill amends the Catawba Indian Tribe of South Carolina Land Claims Settlement Act of 1993 to remove specific statutory membership restrictions, allowing the tribe to determine its own future membership.
